changelog: Fixed: A temporary license-server problem no longer removes this PC's saved activation, so you are not asked to activate again afterwards
Improved: License messages now explain the real reason when UltraGrab Pro cannot start (saved activation missing or unreadable, server busy, no internet connection, device reset)
Improved: The licensing-migration notice is shown only when it applies
Fixed: If a license is revoked or can no longer be confirmed while UltraGrab Pro is open, the app now shows the license message and closes as intended
Improved: Safer license diagnostics in the log for support, with no license numbers, credentials or tokens recorded
